# evroc_filestore (Resource)

Manages an evroc FileStore — a managed file system for shared storage.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the file store.
- `zone` (String) Availability zone for the file store.

### Optional

- `project` (String) Project this resource belongs to. Defaults to the provider project.
- `region` (String) Region where the file store will be created.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `user_labels` (Map of String) User-defined labels (key/value pairs) for organizing and selecting resources.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the file store was created.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `nfs_endpoint` (String) NFS server IP or hostname for mounting.
- `nfs_export_path` (String) NFS export path on the server.
- `nfs_version` (String) NFS protocol version (e.g. V4.1).
- `status` (String) Current lifecycle status (Pending, Reconciling, Provisioning, Available, Released, Failed).
- `system_labels` (Map of String) System-managed labels automatically set by evroc (read-only).
